workload.description: f4_lane_probe lockstep: splitting-tree node assignments shared across the targets of icv1-f2m17-tm101-00378d4e dim 6 (8 targets), icv1-f2m23-tm5197-1f85e9e1 dim 7 (4), icv1-f2m23-t5197-69e76b73 dim 8 (4), icv1-f2m31-tm90707-c95f16f5 dim 9 (4, budget 2000), inherited F4 and F6-IC + pair index, m = 3

metric: share of stage unit spent at nodes reached by two or more targets
note: 66-83 % (f4) and 94-97 % (f6p) of the stage unit is at nodes several targets reach, but their bases share the pivot pattern in only 3-14 % of root columns and bit-slicing over F2 cannot beat packed rows below 64 lanes, so no tree lane engine was built. Gate-first leaves the inherited-F4 arm's stage unit unchanged on all four cells (no node oracle there).
